LanguageData.Mint.GearMenuDesc: Activate a button to open a gear management menu which allows you to drag and drop available gear onto any pawn
LanguageData.Mint.AssignMenuDesc: Replace the default assign menu with a mint version
LanguageData.Mint.ShowMintBillsButtonTip: Show the mint bills button on the main tabs list along the bottom of the screen
LanguageData.ReplacePlantMenuTip: Open the mint plant menu instead of vanilla drop down, if disabled you can ctrl click to open the mint menu instead
LanguageData.Mint.PinCompareTip: Pin the last hovered bill and compare it with the bill under the mouse
LanguageData.Mint.CloneWorktable: Clone the bill stack from this worktable
LanguageData.Mint.SelectABenchToAddBills: Select a bench to add a bill
LanguageData.AutoCloseArchitectDesc: Closes the architect menu when a designator is selected
LanguageData.EnablePinningResourcesTip: Ctrl click on things in the resource readout to pin them to the top (category mode only)
LanguageData.ShowHideResourceListTip: Hide the resource readout on the left of the screen
LanguageData.BillSearchTip:
Searchable words include:

Any words in bill labels or product labels e.g. pants

Stuff categories e.g. leather

Body part groups e.g. head

Tags e.g. industrial

Layers e.g. overhead
LanguageData.MintWheelEditMode: Click designators in the architect menu to add them to the wheel\nDrag and drop to arrange in the wheel
LanguageData.MintWheelRightClickDesc: Open the Mint wheel on right click instead of opening the architect menu
LanguageData.AutoFocusSearchDesc: Automatically focus the search box to start typing each time the build menu is opened
LanguageData.OverrideArchitectTabDesc: Make the mint build menu the default architect tab (hold ctrl for default)
LanguageData.OverrideResearchTabDesc: Make the mint research menu the default research tab (hold ctrl for default)
LanguageData.Mint.PinCompareBuildingTip: Pin this building and compare it with the building under the mouse. Shift+click any building to pin it.
LanguageData.Mint.SortTip: Sort the buildings on show by a stat and show each one's value. Pick the same stat again to reverse the order. With no category selected, every category is ranked together and buildings without the stat are left out.
LanguageData.Mint.PinCategoryTip: Pin this category to the top of the list
LanguageData.Mint.WheelLayoutTip: Wheel: rings around the mouse.\nGrid: rows and columns around the mouse.
LanguageData.Mint.WheelSizingTip: Fixed: a set number of slots that keep their place, empty ones shown.\nAuto: the wheel or grid grows as you add buttons.
LanguageData.Mint.AutoWheelEditMode: Click designators in the architect or Mint build menu to add them, or click one already on the wheel to take it off. Click a button first to put the next designators in front of it.\nDrag buttons to swap them, right-click to take one off.
LanguageData.Mint.DesignatorBarsTip: Rows of designator buttons that stay on screen. Set them up with the cog that shows when the mouse is over a bar.
LanguageData.Mint.BarSetupHelp: Click a slot, then click designators in the architect or Mint build menu to fill it.\nDrag slots to rearrange them, right-click to clear one. Drag a bar by its title.
LanguageData.Mint.DeleteBarConfirm: Delete this bar and its buttons?
LanguageData.Mint.FixedWheelEditMode: Click a slot, then click designators in the architect or Mint build menu to fill it. With no slot chosen, a click adds to the first empty slot, or takes a designator already on the wheel off.\nDrag slots to swap them, right-click to clear one.
LanguageData.Mint.WheelFull: The Mint wheel is full. Add a ring in the wheel's setup.
